title: nan
key_contribution: Presents PSD (Point-to-Surfel Distance), a probabilistic 6D localization algorithm using 3D laser scanners on 2.5D surfel maps for mobile robots in landmark-free GPS-denied rough terrain.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
